messages:
Marta (mktg): Quick - locking announce for Optimize v2. Need final changelog lines, docs URL, and exact rollout window. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/499 . Docs preview: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2-preview . Can eng confirm by 4pm PT?

Lena (eng): Proposed plan: canary 09:45 PT (5%), pin demo variant for webinar at 10:30 PT, promote to 100% by 13:00 PT if green. I'll add a brief rollback snippet to changelog.

Emily (docs): I'll finish screenshots and the API example by 15:30 PT. Final docs will be https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2 . Adding redirect from /optimize.

Priya (prod-marketing): Need the benchmark line for hero: median at 6k context and token cost delta. Lena, can you confirm quick stats?

Lena (eng): Use: "~35% median latency reduction at 6k context; ~28% token cost reduction with new batching defaults." Pasting raw benchmark link in the PR.

Marta (mktg): Great. Alerting: page #eng-oncall if error rate > 0.9% during rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Lena at 2026-03-26T09:45:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall.

Lena (eng): Canary live, 5% -> optimize-v2-demo. Health checks green. Demo endpoint pinned.

Emily (docs): Docs updated and redirect in place. Final URL live.

Marta (mktg): We plan publish at 13:15 PT. Priya will queue socials and press kit. If anyone wants to pause, speak now.

Lena (eng): Promotion rolling: 25% now.

Priya (prod-marketing): Draft queued for 13:15 PT. Leads from demo route to demo-ops inbox.

Lena (eng): 100% promotion complete at 13:02 PT. All metrics stable.

Marta (mktg): Launch live. I'll file retro notes and close thread."
